instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Pull the messages from the Discord text channels my bot can read", and give it nothing more: every input is optional.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:pull-my-discord-messages and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Reads the text and announcement channels of every server the bot is in (only those the bot may view and read the history of), newest messages first, and answers them folded into held: a message pulled twice appears once, an edited message replaces the older copy, and a renamed channel takes its new title. The bot cannot read anyone's personal direct messages, and a message's text is empty unless the bot has the Message Content setting.
4. It reads and writes no rows: the new or changed conversations and items are in the answer, and held.cursor is what to hand back next time.
